page.description: Mageia editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A community distribution with its own installer, control centre and package set, published once a year. One x86_64 image.
pros: Its own drakx installer and Mageia Control Center.
A yearly release cycle with long support for each version.
Runs on modest hardware with the Xfce or LXQt desktops available at install.
The publisher signs ISOs with SHA-512 and SHA-3.
cons: This publisher ships no SHA-256, so ROMinit lists a SHA-512 pin and does not offer USB preparation.
Smaller package selection than the large distributions.
Only the month (July 2026) is published for this release; the page uses the 1st accordingly.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Mageia; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One path: the x86_64 ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. Mageia publishes SHA-512 for this image, so ROMinit offers the download but not USB preparation. The release is listed as July 2026; the version date above uses the 1st because no exact day is published.
